decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed outbuilding would, by reason of its size, design, appearance and position on the boundary, be an over dominant feature that would have an adverse effect on the amenity enjoyed by neighbouring occupants and the character and appearance of the area. The proposal would be contrary to policies ENV.1.1 and H.3.4 and of the Unitary Development Plan and ENVB.1.1 and H.6.4 of the Unitary Development Plan Proposed Alterations Revised Deposit and the Supplementary Planning Guidance. .

Condition : 2 - The retention of the outbuilding would result in the loss of the on site parking spaces which are required to be maintained by condition 4 of planning consent reference 00094/G/P5 and would therefore be prejudicial to the free flow of traffic and general safety of road users. The proposal would be contrary to policies ENV.1.1 and T.2.5 of the Unitary Development Plan and ENVB.1.1 and T.1.4 of the Unitary Development Plan Proposed Alterations Revised Deposit.
description: Retention of a detached outbuilding rear of building for uses laundry, store & office
